description: Visual workbench for AI coding agents: a desktop app plus a headless server, vendor-neutral across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers.
notes: The desktop app (juggler-app.exe) and the server (juggler.exe) ship as one unit and must stay in the same folder - the app spawns the server sitting beside it.
`juggler` runs the headless server in the terminal; press b to open the browser UI.
Sessions, credentials and settings are stored in %USERPROFILE%\.juggler (override with JUGGLER_CONFIG_DIR).
